title: The Beekeeper 2 Gets New Footage With Jason Statham
text:
Amazon reveals new look at The Beekeeper 2
This article covers a developing story. Continue to check back with us as we will be adding more information as it becomes available.At CinemaCon 2026, Amazon MGM Studios revealed new footage for the upcoming film, The Beekeeper 2.
A car drives through a forest road. Inside a mansion, Jeremy Irons is told someone is coming to kill him. The car bursts through the garden and is met with gunfire. The car stops and the soldiers see a dead body inside. Jason Statham watches from afar. He goes into the house and puts a gun to the head of Irons. He tells Statham that the beekeepers have gone wrong. Statham is looking for his friend. Irons says he doesn't know where she is. We see action scenes including Statham taking down masked bad guys on a street, using their guns to hit them in the stomach and head. Statham says that bee stings help stop the bleeding of his wounds. Irons says that the beekeepers have kidnapped the president. A soldier with a flamethrower tells Statham “welcome home” and Statham takes him down. He says humans can learn a lot from bees. Irons gets Statham a car which has a turret attached, and he uses it against a group of soldiers on an air strip. Statham is then seen dropping a group of bees into a locked room with enemies, and the bees then attack them. The Beekeeper 2 Like Follow Followed Action Crime Thriller Release Date January 15, 2027 Director Timo Tjahjanto Writers Kurt Wimmer Producers Jason Statham, Chris Long, Kurt Wimmer Cast
